title: Observed pnpm and Bun GitHub Actions run comparison

requestedBaseline.replacementReason: Use the recent successful prior full-installer pnpm run; its lockfile and CI workflow match the requested pre-migration baseline.

precision: GitHub API job and step timestamps have one-second precision. A zero-second step is below this timestamp resolution, not proof of zero work. Aggregates inherit this precision.

definitions.workflowWallSeconds: Run created_at through updated_at; includes initial runner queue time and workflow finalization.
definitions.jobSpanSeconds: Earliest job started_at through latest job completed_at; excludes initial workflow queue time and includes dependencies and scheduling gaps.
definitions.aggregateRunnerSeconds: Sum of job started_at through completed_at intervals. This is aggregate runner elapsed time, not CPU time, billed minutes or cost; OS billing multipliers are not applied.
definitions.installSeconds: Successful Install dependencies and Run pnpm/bun install --frozen-lockfile steps only; excludes cache restore/save and runtime/package-manager setup.
definitions.dependencyPreparationSeconds: Successful install steps, pnpm/setup-bun/setup-node action steps and their post actions, and Bun package cache restore/save steps.
definitions.commonJobs: Jobs matched by their exact displayed names. Excludes the new Bun runtime integration job from common-job aggregates.

caveats: This is one uncontrolled pair of successful runs, not a same-commit A/B benchmark or evidence of a causal Bun speedup.
The pnpm run was a main push and the Bun run was a manual dispatch. Both included the four-platform installer matrix.
The source commits differ, and the Bun workflow adds a separate integration job while retaining Node 22/24 test shards.
Cold/warm package and executable cache states are unknown: cache-hit outputs and logs were not sampled. Cache action durations are included where indicated.
Runner contention, dependency/browser downloads, cache transfer and packaging duration vary. Initial workflow queue time also differed.
Install-step timing improved in these observations, but total pipeline wall time did not.
